description: Set one key in the room's shared memory. Pass if_version = the version you read to avoid overwriting a newer value (you get a conflict instead). Keep values small and factual.

if_version.description: Only write if the current version is this.

token.description: Optional API key (zck_...), session token or guest requester_token for this call only. Overrides the connection's Authorization header. Use it to follow up on a request you posted as a guest.

name: room_memory_set
title: Write room memory
